clean_story:
Plastic interlocking bricks. Endless building possibilities.
The name Lego comes from the Danish words "leg godt," meaning "play well."
Each brick’s clutch power—its ability to stick together—comes from tiny tubes inside that grip the studs of another brick with precision, like a key fitting into a lock. This design lets builders create anything from a simple house to a moving robot. A standard 2x4 Lego brick can be combined in 915 million ways with just six others.
Three related subjects are modular design, toy engineering and creativity tools.
